subject: Billing contact & invoice delivery preference for Greenlight Corp
messages:
From: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@greenlight.co>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-18 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: New billing contact + invoice delivery preference

Hi Evelyn,

Quick intro — I’m Sophie in AP at Greenlight. We’re starting our Redwood contract (GF-4521) and I need to confirm how you prefer to send invoices. Our AP team prefers a portal push (if available) but we require an emailed PDF copy to billing@greenlight.co for internal matching. Also we’re VAT-registered in the UK (GB123456789) and need a VAT breakdown on each invoice.

Please confirm:
- Default invoice originator (portal push vs emailed PDF)
- Whether we can get a separate remittance address on the invoice
- Any fields you need from our side (PO, remit, VAT number)

Attaching our PO for the initial invoice.

Thanks,
Sophie Lane
Accounts Payable
Greenlight Corp
(attachment: PO_4521.pdf)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@greenlight.co>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-18 10:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: New billing contact + invoice delivery preference

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note and the PO, welcome aboard. Short answers up front, then a recommended workflow.

1) Default delivery: Redwood issues invoices into the billing portal (recommended) and we can send an automated PDF copy via email to your billing address. If you prefer email-only we can do that as well but portal-first is our standard for auditability.
2) Remittance address: yes, we can set a remit block on the PDF and in the portal metadata. Please confirm exact text.
3) Required fields: PO number (we have PO_4521), remit address, VAT number (we have GB123456789) and preferred billing contact (name + email).

If portal access is acceptable, we’ll create a portal primary contact (accounts@greenlight.co) and set billing@greenlight.co as an email copy recipient. That preserves your AP workflow while giving you structured invoice data and downloadable XML if needed. We also support SFTP push and e-invoicing (Peppol) for EU customers.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm remit address and whether accounts@greenlight.co should be portal admin.
- I’ll enable "portal primary + email copy" for Greenlight and generate the initial invoice PDF with VAT line items.

Attaching our invoice schema for fields we populate.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachment: invoice-schema-v2.pdf)

Remit address: Greenlight Corp, 14 King Street, London, SW1A 1AA

Eve — quick internal. We should:
- Enable portal-primary + email-copy for Greenlight (matches policy for EU VAT customers).
- Add a custom "PO line descriptions" metadata field so the invoice XML includes line-level text. Connor, can you confirm the tenant metadata keys?
- Keep Peppol off unless customer asks; note we need finance signoff for Peppol onboarding (compliance + ~2 week enable window).

Connor: if we set the portal admin to accounts@greenlight.co, do we auto-create a billing tenant user or send an invite link? I’d rather an invite so they confirm ownership.

— Marcus

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: New billing contact + invoice delivery preference

Hi Sophie — all set on our side. Summary of what we configured for GF-4521:

- Invoice delivery: Portal-primary; automated PDF copy emailed to billing@greenlight.co
- Portal admin invite: sent to accounts@greenlight.co (they need to accept to manage invoices)
- Remit address: set to "Greenlight Corp, 14 King Street, London, SW1A 1AA" on PDF and portal metadata
- VAT: GB123456789 will appear as a line on invoices; VAT amounts broken out per line
- PO data: we included PO_4521 and enabled a PO line-description field in the invoice XML for your AP matcher

Expect the initial invoice to appear in the portal within 24 hours. I’ll follow up with a DocuSign link if you want the billing contact added to the contract; otherwise the portal invite is sufficient for invoice access.

If anything changes (e.g., need SFTP or Peppol), reply here and we’ll schedule enablement.

Best regards,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
